name: Cohere
tagline: Enterprise-grade large language models and embeddings via API
description: Cohere provides a REST API for text generation, chat, embeddings, and reranking using its Command and Embed model families. Developers authenticate with an API key and call production endpoints for RAG, semantic search, and generative applications. (The v1 Classify endpoint is deprecated.)

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY; self-serve from dashboard

pricing.free_tier_limits: Trial key: 1,000 API calls/month; production usage is metered and model-specific (not a free production tier).

rate_limits: Published by key type and endpoint (docs.cohere.com/docs/rate-limits): Chat trial ~20 RPM, production typically ~500 RPM for applicable models; Embed ~2,000 inputs/minute; Rerank trial ~10 RPM, production ~1,000 RPM. Some newer models require contacting sales; limits are model-specific.

use_cases: generate chat completions with Command models
create text embeddings for semantic search
